points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA for cognitive AI applications.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for NLP and Generative AI solutions.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability for AI/ML services.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, reliable production inference on Azure cloud infrastructure.
\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25% and improving user experience while maintaining system coverage in enterprise environments.
